summary: Final Implementation Plan (Plan 12) incorporating the Owner's two final requirements: (1) Mandatory verification of the highest Version Code in Google Play Console, requiring explicit TWA_VERSION_CODE before any release build with zero hardcoded assumptions; and (2) A non-invasive shared-account synchronization test suite verifying identical Firebase UID, Plan, Wallet, Credits, Creation History, and bidirectional credit balance reflection between Website and TWA without altering existing Auth, Firestore, or Wallet logic.
